files.description: Primary EHI export documentation PDF (4 pages). Describes three export formats: C-CDA XML, FHIR Bulk Data, and supplemental Excel/document exports. Covers single and multi-patient export. No data dictionary or field-level documentation. Created 2025-08-14.

FHIR API documentation page referenced by the EHI export PDF as part of the FHIR Bulk Data export mechanism. Documents 29 US Core STU 3.1.1 resource types with API endpoints (GET/POST). This is the (g)(10) FHIR API documentation, not (b)(10)-specific. Includes client registration, OAuth2 authorization, and resource-level API details.
